messages:
sarah_seller: Quick sync — Prospect (regulated fintech) wants an air-gapped POC in ~3 weeks. Requirements: 3-node GPU cluster, no outbound access, HSM-backed keywrap, quarterly upgrade windows, delta bundles only, signed artifacts, and a 4-hour offline activation SLA. Can we meet packaging + hotfix cadence?

amit_solomon: +1 on timeline. main questions: how big can a delta be before their ops team balks? they asked for <150MB deltas and minimal restart.

jules_packaging: We can do chunked deltas with a streaming apply. 150MB is tight but doable if we avoid bundling multiple quantized variants. Need to know model size and whether they require multiple model families in the POC.

liam_sec: HSM/KMS note: we support customer HSMs via PKCS#11 for key unwrap. For air-gapped, we'll need signed manifests and an offline key exchange step. Also need to confirm whether they permit any transient outbound telemetry (usually a blocker).

nina_pm: Prospect says no telemetry at all. They want audit logs delivered via log export (SFTP) only. Also asked about emergency hotfixes between quarterly windows — legal wants a documented exception process.

leo_infra: For activation within 4 hours we need: pre-signed bundle on USB, a bootstrap operator that accepts a signed manifest, and a snapshot of runtime images. We can do incremental apply with zero-downtime for worker processes but control-plane changes (schema, config) may require short restarts (~2-5 mins).

jules_packaging: Example bootstrap command we'd give to ops (for docs):
```bash
rwd-bootstrap --bundle /media/usb/rwd-airgap-2026-03.delta.tar.gz \
              --manifest /media/usb/rwd-manifest.sig \
              --offline --kms-provider=pkcs11 \
              --accept-license
```
Note: bundle includes a chunk index so we can resume apply if a node reboots.

amit_solomon: If we need to cut down delta size, we can: 1) strip optional model variants, 2) ship quantized weights only, 3) rely on local cache prepopulation. Which of those is allowed?

sarah_seller: Customer prefers to keep FP16 weights for quality; they said quantized acceptable for non-prod. They can pre-stage model cache on the nodes but need to know exact paths and checksums.

liam_sec: We'll provide a signed manifest with checksums and a verification tool. Also need to confirm PKCS#11 vendor and allowed permissions (wrap/unwrap only). They won't hand over HSM; it's on their side. We need clear steps for key import + attestation.

nina_pm: On hotfixes between quarterly windows: propose SLA-backed emergency patch path with an approval chain (security contact + engineering on-call) and a signed small-patch bundle (<50MB) that can be applied with zero model interruption. Legal to review.

leo_infra: Ops constraint: offline bundle activation within 4 hours is feasible if we pre-validate bundle signatures and the operator runs with --fast-apply mode (streams chunks, parallel writes). We should test on identical infra (3x A40/A100) to validate timings.

jules_packaging: Packaging action items: create a slim delta profile for the POC (no debug symbols, single quantization profile for prod-sim), produce a signed manifest, and produce an apply/resume log file format for their auditors. ETA: prototype bundle within 10 business days.

liam_sec: Security action items: provide PKCS#11 integration doc, offline attestation checklist, and sample manifest format. Also confirm that the bundle signing key will be Redwood-controlled or customer-controlled. Customer prefers customer-controlled keys.

sarah_seller: I'll confirm key ownership and the exact HSM vendor today. Also looping in customer's infra contact. Can we get an estimated POC cost delta for the additional signing/airgap work? finance needs a number for the SOW.

nina_pm: Rough engineering uplift estimate: 2 wks eng + 1 wk infra validation for prototype, plus 1-day field support during first activation. I'll convert to a rough cost and share.

deploy-bot: build 4351f1 -> staging-bundles: rwd-airgap-2026-03.delta.tar.gz uploaded (size 128MB) :package: :rocket:

jules_packaging: Nice — uploaded bundle size 128MB matches their threshold. I'll prepare the signed manifest and checksum file and post here once ready.

sarah_seller: Thanks all, will update the prospect and share the scheduled test window. :thumbsup:
